slides.title: Bar owners: 3 dates to check before New Year's Eve
The liquor license on the wall has a renewal date.
slides.body: Check it now, not on December 30.

slides.title: Your new December bartenders need current server cards.
slides.body: Many areas require them, and they expire too.

slides.title: Patio party? Your normal permit may not cover it.
slides.body: Special events can need their own permit. Ask the city early.

slides.title: Midnight is for the countdown, not the paperwork.
slides.body: CertTrack tracks expiration dates and alerts you before they expire.
